messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automatic alert: Ingress proxy cluster 'edge-us-east-1' is reporting a sudden spike in 5xx responses (502/504) and increased backend timeouts. Error rate ~18% over last 2m. Triggered page to oncall. Logs aggregated to https://logs.redwood.example/trace/1807773331

oliver (oncall): On it. paging SRE, @kevin can you join? grabbing recent traces now. Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

maya (infra): seeing large fanout to a subset of backend pool nodes (pod-az2-*). KV cache miss rate jumped, and TCP retries up. P95 latency at edge jumped from 45ms -> 1.8s.

kevin (sre): I see upstream timeouts from our gateway to model-router service. A bunch of 504s with TTL exceeded error in the gateway. Attaching short log snippet:
```
[2026-06-12T14:12:21Z] gateway edge-us-east-1 -> model-router-az2-07 : POST /v1/generate 504, conn_timeout
[2026-06-12T14:12:23Z] gateway edge-us-east-1 -> model-router-az2-09 : 502, read: connection reset by peer
[2026-06-12T14:12:24Z] gateway edge-us-east-1 -> model-router-az2-07 : 504, downstream timeout
```

kevin (sre): hypothesis: partial outage of model-router instances in az2 causing cascading retries/fanout at the edge. Suggest: temporarily exclude az2 from gateway routing, reduce gateway retry multiplier, enable circuit-breaker for model-router.

oliver (oncall): Can you run the route exclusion? I can flip circuit-breaker if you want.

maya (infra): Starting region failover: marking az2 nodes unhealthy in LB (manual). Command: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/healthsets/edge-us-east-1 -d '{"exclude_zones":["az2"]}'` — executing now.

deploy-bot: healthset update accepted. New routing policy applied: exclude_zones=[az2]. Propagation 30s.

samir (eng): Rolling back a recent model-router config? There was a canary deployed 13m ago that touched keepalive settings. Not sure if related. Can we pin to previous revision for az2?

kevin (sre): Good call. Querying deploys: `kubectl -n infra get deploy model-router -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Progressing")].lastUpdateTime}'` -> last rollout 00:13:40. I'll trigger safe rollback for az2 group: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-router --to-revision=42 --selector=zone=az2` (will coordinate with maya).

maya (infra): Rollback started for az2 subset. ETA ~90s. Watch logs for 502s.

oliver (oncall): Customer impact check: any errors tying back to auth or specific customers?

nina (product): We're seeing elevated 5xx across multiple tenants; top customer-facing errors are timeouts during generation calls. No SSO/auth issues. Ticket queue shows ~120 new support hits in last 10m referencing "service unavailable". Potentially broad impact.

kevin (sre): After excluding az2, error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in 45s. Still above baseline. Some backend pods in other zones are showing elevated load due to traffic shift. Suggest enabling prefix caching for common requests as short-term relief.

samir (eng): Enabling prefix cache for heavy routes now (safe toggle): `POST /admin/cache/toggle?prefix=/v1/generate&ttl=60` -> response 200.

oliver (oncall): Good. Can we also reduce gateway retry attempts to avoid amplifying load? Current policy retries=3 with multiplier 2.

maya (infra): Set gateway retry config to retries=1, multiplier=1. Command: `gpctl set edge.retries=1 edge.multiplier=1` -> applied.

deploy-bot: config change detected and applied to edge cluster.

kevin (sre): Observability: p50 still ok, p95 down to 220ms, error rate drifting to 2.1% now. Looks acceptable but keep monitor.

oliver (oncall): Do we need to page infra oncall for a full node replacement in az2?

maya (infra): We're investigating root cause — early signs point to ephemeral memory leak in the canary revision causing OOMKill on a subset of pods. Rolling rollback should fix it. If error spikes again after rollback we escalate.

nina (product): Notifying CS + support with status: short blurb ready: "We identified a partial outage affecting request routing in one availability zone causing elevated 5xxs. We've rerouted traffic and applied mitigations; errors are decreasing. We'll update when fully resolved." Want to include ETA?

oliver (oncall): ETA tentative 30-45m to full stabilization (monitoring dependent). Use cautious wording.

samir (eng): Rollback for az2 completed. New pods healthy. `kubectl get pods -l app=model-router -o wide` shows readiness 98%.

kevin (sre): Post-rollback telemetry: error rate now at 0.7%, p95 ~80ms. No new OOMs on model-router. Looks stable. I'm going to keep alerts muted for 10m to avoid noise but will continue to watch traces.

oliver (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff: I'm going to hand this to night oncall in 35m. @kevin please add short incident summary to the incident board and include the runbook link: https://playbooks.redwood.example/gateway-5xx.

kevin (sre): Summary posted to incident board with timeline, mitigation steps, and follow-ups (rollback analysis, add canary rollout guardrails, improve az-level autoscaling).

nina (product): CS update posted to customer status page: "Partial ingress degradation affecting some requests; mitigations applied; service restored for most customers. Follow-up communication to come after RCA."

oliver (oncall): Final check — any remaining action items?

maya (infra): Needs: 1) confirm automatic az exclusion logic to avoid manual action next time, 2) probe failures on az2 nodes for disk/memory anomalies, 3) add a canary rollback automation guard. I'll file infra tickets.

samir (eng): I'll add a revision guard to our deployment pipeline to prevent keepalive misconfig from shipping without load tests.

kevin (sre): I'll schedule a short post-incident blameless postmortem and include timeline + metrics.

oliver (oncall): Cool. Leaving channel now and creating handoff note to night oncall (ts=1807777100). If the error rate creeps above 2% re-escalate. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread archived. If you'd like to reopen, react with :rotating_light:
